scripts.build:production: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:edge
scripts.deploy:frontend: npm run build:frontend && npm --workspace apps/worker exec wrangler pages deploy ../../apps/web/dist --project-name intelligym --branch main
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && python -m ruff check apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && python -m mypy apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && python -m pytest apps/api/tests
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --workspaces --if-present && python -m ruff format --check apps/api
